crossRefs.note: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.
Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
“Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power…
We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.
But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less…
Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting…
I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”
But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as…

translations.web: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
translations.bsb: Indeed, God is great—beyond our knowledge; the number of His years is unsearchable.
translations.kjv: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.
translations.asv: Behold, God is great, and we know him not; The number of his years is unsearchable.
